keyFindings.description: Required check `lint` red at d308efe8: check-private-names.sh refused both handoff lines, each naming the deployment repository's Dispatch project key beside the 660 s budget. Fixed in 28649d1914d9 and 48022b2c78a6; lint success at 9303ce81.

The docs promised a refusal for every pod-block volume naming a missing object; the kubelet attempts no volume no container mounts. Fixed in 71df6dc30506: each sentence holds the refusal to a volume a volume_mounts entry mounts and says why; the tester re-read the kubelet's populator at v1.35.8.

The live check's 30 s bound tolerated one missed recheck. Fixed in 74cc68d4960f: 2*mountRecheck + 15 s (45 s), refusal substrings unchanged, README row updated; unmeasured until the devbox run (PR body Not proven / risk).

A FailedMount the kubelet has since cleared is still refused on the recheck; one extra restart, the spec's design, the providers rule's prior shape. Not a defect; declined by the implementer, accepted by the reviewer; carried in Not proven / risk.
